Elements hidden via inline style="font-size:0" render nothing and must not appear in the output

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<p>visible</p><div style=\"font-size:0px; color:rgb(255,255,255)\"><span style=\"line-height:0\">secret zero size text</span></div><p>also visible</p>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
